resources.string: Use the previous algorithm in Explore and on title details.

On title details, suggest similar works using only the opened title and its related works. Ignore reading tastes and the variety slider there. Turn off to restore personalized details suggestions. Explore is unchanged. Sparse source metadata may give fewer results.
Recommend started titles with new chapters
Only confirmed unread releases since your last reading session count. Caught-up titles stay hidden.
Optional AniList and MangaUpdates requests send selected title identifiers or search queries. History, statistics and your taste profile stay on this device.
Empty selection includes all languages. Sources with multiple or unknown languages remain available.

Beta: ranking uses favorites, reading history and available statistics locally. Quality depends on source metadata and candidate availability. Similar names may refer to different works or adaptations. Long-press a recommendation to hide it; Undo restores it. No reading progress or favorite categories are changed.
No sources match your current preferences. Install or enable a suitable source, then try again.
Choose the same work and edition
Check the title, edition and adaptation. A wrong match can give unrelated recommendations. This only saves a recommendation match; it does not link a tracker or add a favorite.
Recommendations need a connection allowed by your Wi-Fi preference.
